_doc: Machine-readable manifest of the executable components INCLUDED in the published release Docker image, and those deliberately EXCLUDED. scripts/ci/check_release_publish.py fails closed if any included component is not release_verified or lock-anchored, if a transport_trusted component is included, or if the browser payload is not excluded. Each anchor is cross-checked against the real Dockerfile / lockfiles.

included_components.name: npm-deps
included_components.detail: npm install against committed package-lock.json (sha512 integrity)

excluded_components.name: playwright-browser
excluded_components.reason: Unverified browser payload with no committed archive digest. Absent from the release image; resolved at runtime through the gated agent-browser path when the operator opts in. Bake it only after pinning exact Playwright browser archive digests in supply-chain/manifest.json.
